# Cv (web)

<!-- module-flows:start (generated by .claude/bin/module-index; do not edit) -->

Flows: [`public-site`](../../flows/public-site/FLOW.md).

<!-- module-flows:end -->

## Purpose

Renders the public CV at `/cv`: the main `page-cv-a`, the `profile` as the contact card and the labels of `cvCommonText`, all read server-side and passed to the client view; a signed-in visitor refetches the data with their token ([public-site flow](../../flows/public-site/FLOW.md)).

## Techniques

Page layout of web RULES "Page layout": `PageCv.tsx` (Server Component) loads through `PageCv.data.ts` (`loadPageCv`, React `cache`, shared by `generateMetadata` and the page); no main CV calls `notFound()`, a failed read or a null `cvCommonText` still raises `NO_DATA` until CSF-4. The four query strings (`PageCvA`, `Profile`, `CvCommonText`, `PageCvVisitor`) are in `PageCv.graphql.ts` (the selections written once) and run through `executeGraphql` in `PageCv.data.ts`; a failed profile is `null`, a failed list or text throws; the BFF route `GET /api/v1/cv` binds `answerCvRead` from the same file. Server data first: anonymous visitors (and everyone's first paint) get the server-rendered data without a request; a signed-in session refetches per actor, signing out falls back to the server data, a failed refetch keeps the server CV with no message. Labels come from `cvCommonText` only (section titles from `summary`, `skills`, `experiences`, `projects`, `educations`; `teamSize` and `technologies`); a label with no field (contact, loading, masked text, fallback name, link names, unnamed project) is left out, and with a null `cvCommonText` every label is left out. Loading is an empty busy `output`; no name means no `h1`; a masked value is left out when no masked text is provided, never shown raw; links show their URL; unsafe link targets render as text; richtext is sanitized on the server only (D13).

## Technologies

React, TanStack Query.

## Entry points

`PageCv` and its `generateMetadata` (rendered and re-exported by `app/cv/page.tsx`), `answerCvRead` (bound by `app/api/v1/cv/route.ts`).

## Where to change what

A field or label: `PageCv.graphql.ts` (selection and types) and `apis/server/graphql/mocks/PageCv.mock.ts`; a new section: a `<Name>Section.tsx` file plus one line in `PageCv.client.tsx`; contact items: `ContactCard.tsx`; who sees which data: `usePageCvData` in `PageCv.client.tsx`; what is loaded and how it fails: `PageCv.data.ts`.
